title: Planning Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities Develop and maintain detailed Engineering & construction schedules in coordination with the Project Manager. Track daily and weekly project progress against the approved baseline. Analyse schedule variances and forecast project completion. Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly look-ahead schedules . Identify critical path activities, delays, and schedule risks and support recovery plans. Coordinate and integrate contractor schedules into the overall master programme. Prepare progress dashboards, S-curves, and project analytics . Support preparation of monthly progress reports , including physical/financial progress, delays, and corrective actions. Required Skills Strong hands-on experience in MS Project/ Primavera P6 . Good knowledge of baseline management, critical path analysis, S-curve, and Earned Value Management (EVM) . Experience in integrating multi-discipline contractor programmes . Strong analytical, reporting, coordination, and communication skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and data visualisation . 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 36 years of experience in construction planning and scheduling . Experience in large industrial, EPC, or cleanroom projects will be preferred. B.E./B.Tech in Civil/Mechanical Engineering or Diploma with strong planning experience. Primavera P6/ MS Projects certification will be an added advantage. Strong analytical ability with attention to detail and the ability to work under project deadlines.

Key Skills: Primavera P6,Primavera Project Planner,Industrial Construction,Project Planning,Planning Engineering,Project Scheduling,Planning,Project

title: Project Manager
description:
Designation: Project Manager 
 Qualification: Bachlor/ master in engineering - Civil, Mechanical, Bsc, Msc   Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience (project management)  Job description: Key Responsibilities
1. Project Planning & Execution
* Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.
* Develop full-scale project plans, including resource allocation, timelines, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Coordinate the deployment of field inspectors, technicians, and specialized equipment to various sites.
2. Client & Stakeholder Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, providing regular progress updates and addressing technical concerns.
* Manage client expectations and ensure high levels of satisfaction through proactive communication.
* Negotiate contracts, manage change orders, and handle project closures.
3. Quality & Safety Compliance (HSE)
* Ensure all inspection activities adhere to ISO, ASTM or other relevant industry standards.
* Enforce strict Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) protocols on-site to maintain a zero-incident culture.
* Review technical documentation before delivery to the client.
4. Financial Oversight
* Track project budgets, monitor "burn rates," and ensure projects remain profitable.
* Manage invoicing schedules and oversee procurement for project-specific consumables or rentals.

Key Skills: Site Execution,Project Execution,Site Management,Project Management,Project Planning,Planning,Site,Project
